kis.title: Developer Laptop (Mac)
kis.description: Service catalog item for Apple Developer Laptop (Mac)
kis.content: Developer Laptop (Mac) is a hardware catalog item priced at $1,499.00 plus $100.00 annually, with a delivery time of 5 days. It features an Apple Macbook Pro with Intel Core i7 processor, 512GB PCIe-based flash storage, Intel Iris Pro Graphics, backlit keyboard, and optional software choices including Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop, and Eclipse IDE.

kis.title: Development Laptop (PC)
kis.description: Corporate standard developer laptop catalog item (Dell XPS 13).
kis.content: Development Laptop (PC) (Dell XPS 13) is a hardware catalog item in the Service Catalog. Base specifications include a 3.1 GHz Intel Core i7 processor, 8 GB RAM, 250 GB Solid State Drive, Ubuntu OS, and software (Tomcat, Eclipse, Firefox, Chrome). Configuration options include upgrading the solid state drive to 500 GB (add $300.00) and specifying the operating system as Windows 8 (add $100.00). Base price is $1,000.00, and standard delivery time is 2 Days.

kis.title: Executive Desktop
kis.description: A Dell Precision 690 desktop catalog item.
kis.content: The Executive Desktop is a catalog item (Dell Precision 690) under the Desktops category of the Service Catalog with a base price of $1,875.00 and a 2-day delivery time.

kis.title: Fireworks

kis.content: Fireworks (Adobe Systems Fireworks) is a catalog item in the Software Catalog under Software, priced at $20.00 with a 1-day delivery time.

kis.title: Galaxy Note 20
kis.description: A Samsung Galaxy Note 20 mobile device catalog item.
kis.content: The Galaxy Note 20 is a mobile phone catalog item in the Service Catalog under Mobiles, priced at $599.00 with a 2-day delivery time.

kis.description: A Motorola Droid Razr Maxx mobile phone catalog item.
kis.content: The Google Droid Razr Maxx (Motorola Droid Razr Maxx 2) is a catalog item under Mobiles in the Hardware Catalog, priced at $99.99 with a 2-day delivery time.

kis.title: Google Nexus 7

kis.content: Google Nexus 7 is a Tablets catalog item under the Hardware Catalog with a base price of $199.99 and a delivery time of 2 Days.

kis.title: iPad mini
kis.description: Catalog item for ordering an Apple iPad mini
kis.content: The iPad mini is a catalog item in the Service Catalog under Hardware. It has a base price of $499.00 and an estimated delivery time of 2 days. It requires selecting a colour (Space Grey, Pink, Purple, Starlight) and storage capacity (64 GB base, or 256 GB adding $150.00). Quantity can be selected from 1 to 10 (defaults to 1).

kis.title: iPad pro
kis.description: Hardware catalog item for ordering an iPad Pro.
kis.content: An Apple tablet available under the Hardware category of the Service Catalog. Base price is $799.00 + $30.00 Monthly with an estimated delivery time of 2 Days. Configurable options are 'Choose the colour' (Space Grey, Silver) and 'Choose the storage' (128 GB, 256 GB at +$100.00, and 512 GB at +$300.00).

kis.title: Loaner Laptop
kis.description: A hardware catalog item for requesting temporary notebook computers.
kis.content: Loaner Laptop is a hardware catalog item in the Service Catalog. It includes the date/time field "When do you need it ?", the duration dropdown "How long do you need it for ?" (with options 1 day, 1 month, 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 days), a Quantity dropdown (1 to 10), and specifies a delivery time of 2 Days.

kis.title: Microsoft Access
kis.description: Software catalog item for Microsoft Access.
kis.content: Microsoft Access is a Software catalog item with a base price of $139.99 and a delivery time of 1 Day.

kis.content: Pixel 4a is a Mobiles catalog item with a base price of $529.00 and a delivery time of 2 Days.

kis.title: Sales Laptop
kis.description: Acer Aspire NX corporate standard laptop for sales employees
kis.content: Sales Laptop is a Hardware catalog item featuring the Acer Aspire NX laptop with a 2.5 GHz Intel Core i5 Processor, 750 GB Hard Drive, 8 GB RAM, Microsoft Windows 8, and Microsoft Office. It has an estimated delivery time of 5 Days. Optional software includes Microsoft Powerpoint, Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop, and Siebel Client.

kis.title: Samsung Galaxy S7 Edge
kis.description: Mobiles catalog item for Samsung Galaxy S7 Edge smartphone.
kis.content: Samsung Galaxy S7 Edge is a Mobiles catalog item with a base price of $669.99 and a delivery time of 2 Days.

kis.title: Standard Laptop
kis.description: Catalog item for ordering a standard laptop (Lenovo - Carbon x1)
kis.content: The Standard Laptop (Lenovo - Carbon x1) is a catalog item in the Service Catalog under Hardware. It costs $1,100.00 plus $100.00 annually with an estimated delivery time of 5 days. Specifications include an Intel core i5 processor, 512GB SSD, and backlit keyboard. Configuration options include checkboxes for Adobe Acrobat and Adobe Photoshop, and a text box for Additional software requirements. Quantity combobox allows 1 to 10 (defaults to 1).

kis.title: Whitelist IP
kis.description: Service catalog item for requesting IP address whitelisting.
kis.content: Whitelist IP is a catalog item under the Services category available in the Service Catalog with a base price of $0.00.

kis.title: Active Interactions Module
kis.description: ServiceNow module showing active interactions.
kis.content: The Active module under the Interaction application displays all non-closed interactions currently being handled.

kis.title: All Assets
kis.description: ServiceNow module under Asset > Portfolios for managing assets.
kis.content: The All Assets module is located under the Asset application in the Portfolios section of the ServiceNow navigation menu (target alm_asset_list.do). It displays company assets across hardware, software licenses, and consumables.

kis.title: Asset
kis.description: ServiceNow application for IT asset management.
kis.content: The Asset application in ServiceNow includes modules across Portfolios (All Assets, Consumables, Hardware Assets, License Assets, Other Assets), Software (Asset License Entitlements, User License Entitlements, License Calculations), Administration (Asset-CI Field Mapping, Asset-CI Install Status mapping, Asset-CI Hardware Status Mapping, Asset Creation Queue), Overview, Asset Tasks, and Asset Workspace.

kis.title: Change
kis.description: ServiceNow Change Management application module.
kis.content: The Change module in ServiceNow manages change requests across their lifecycle. Key modules under Change include Create New, Open, Closed, All, Overview, Standard Change, Change Advisory Board, Schedules, Change Policy, Administration, and Configuration.

kis.title: Dependency Views
kis.description: ServiceNow application for infrastructure and CI dependency visualizations.
kis.content: Dependency Views is a ServiceNow application providing CI relationship visualizations. It includes modules such as View Map, View Map in New Tab, Saved Settings, Saved Views, Map Menu Actions, Map Indicators, Map Related Items, Map Edge Colors, Map Icons, Predefined Filters, Dependency Types, and Map Properties.

kis.title: Elements Filters
kis.description: A module under Performance Analytics in ServiceNow that manages filter definitions for breakdown elements.
kis.content: Elements Filters is a module within Performance Analytics located under the Breakdowns category. It navigates to pa_filters_list.do, displaying existing element filters with columns such as Title, Breakdown source, Filter, and Roles.

kis.title: Expense Lines
kis.description: ServiceNow Cost application module for expense lines.
kis.content: The Expense Lines module is located under the Cost application in ServiceNow (URL target fm_expense_line_list.do). It displays expense lines with fields such as Number, User, Inherited, Parent, Date, Short description, Source ID, Amount, Type, and Summary type.

kis.title: Hardware Assets
kis.description: ServiceNow Asset management module for hardware assets.
kis.content: The Hardware Assets module is located under Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets in the application navigator and displays hardware assets from the alm_hardware table.

kis.title: Hardware Assets Module
kis.description: Hardware Assets module under Asset > Portfolios
kis.content: The Hardware Assets module is located under Asset > Portfolios in the ServiceNow Application Navigator and opens the alm_hardware list of physical assets.

kis.title: Incidents
kis.description: ServiceNow Incidents module under Service Desk
kis.content: The Incidents module under Service Desk in ServiceNow manages IT service incidents, tracking their caller, category, priority, impact, state, and assigned agent.

kis.title: Knowledge
kis.description: ServiceNow module for accessing and managing knowledge articles.
kis.content: The Knowledge module provides access to knowledge base articles. In list view, articles have columns including Number, Published, Topic, Category, Workflow, Short description, and Updated.

kis.title: Maintain Items
kis.description: ServiceNow module for managing service catalog items
kis.content: Maintain Items is a ServiceNow module under Service Catalog > Catalog Definitions that displays and manages catalog items (sc_cat_item_list.do).

kis.title: Private Tasks
kis.description: ServiceNow module and table (vtb_task) for private tasks.
kis.content: Private Tasks in ServiceNow correspond to the vtb_task table (accessible via vtb_task_list.do) associated with Visual Task Boards. Records have PTSK-prefixed numbers and include fields such as Number, Short description, Priority, State, Assigned to, and Updated.

kis.title: Problem
kis.description: ServiceNow application for managing problem records
kis.content: The Problem application in ServiceNow, accessible via the All menu. Its modules include Create New, Assigned to me, Open, Open - Unassigned, Resolved, Risk Accepted, All, Overview, Problem Properties, and ATF Suites.

kis.title: Problems
kis.description: ServiceNow module for tracking and resolving problem investigations.
kis.content: The Problems module manages ServiceNow problem records. Its list view supports field-specific searches on Number, Problem statement, State, Priority, Resolution code, Assigned to, Configuration item, Related Incidents, Category, and Company.

kis.title: Reports
kis.description: ServiceNow reporting application module
kis.content: The Reports application module in ServiceNow allows users to view, run, create, and schedule reports, as well as configure report sources, ranges, and visual properties.

kis.title: Reports > View / Run
kis.description: ServiceNow module for browsing and running reports.
kis.content: The View / Run module under the Reports application (Reports > View / Run) opens the report home page (report_home.do), allowing users to browse, create, and run reports across My reports, Group, Global, and All categories.

kis.title: Reports View / Run Module
kis.description: ServiceNow application module for managing reports.
kis.content: The Reports module in ServiceNow allows users to view, run, and create analytics reports and dashboards, accessed via Reports > View / Run.

kis.title: Requested Items
kis.description: Self-service module listing requested catalog items.
kis.content: The Requested Items module is located under Self-Service. In its Self Service view list, it displays requested catalog items with columns Number, Catalog, Item, Approval, Quantity, and Stage. By default, it filters by Request Requested for = [current user] and Active = true.

kis.title: Service Catalog
kis.description: Service Catalog module under Self-Service
kis.content: The Service Catalog module is located under the Self-Service application in ServiceNow. It contains categories including Services, Can We Help You?, Office, Peripherals, Hardware, Software, Desktops, and Mobiles, and allows users to search and order items.

kis.title: Service Desk
kis.description: ServiceNow module for ticket and incident handling.
kis.content: The Service Desk module in ServiceNow contains IT support workflows, including access to Incidents.

kis.title: System Mobile
kis.description: ServiceNow application for managing mobile platform apps and features.
kis.content: The System Mobile application configures mobile capabilities in ServiceNow. It contains modules and sections including Getting Started, Screens, Launcher Screens, Data Items, Action Items, Functions, Navigation Bar, Mobile App Builder, Mobile Card Builder, Mobile UI, Now Mobile App (Applet Launchers, Navigation Bar, Catalogs, Knowledge Bases, My Request Filters), Search, Mobile Branding, Mobile Push Notifications, and Mobile Universal Linking.

kis.title: Users
kis.description: ServiceNow module for managing user accounts.
kis.content: The Users module in ServiceNow manages user accounts and records (sys_user). It is accessible via the Application Navigator under Organization and User Administration, displaying the list of users and allowing new user creation.

kis.title: Users Module
kis.description: Users module under System Security > Users and Groups
kis.content: The Users module is located under System Security > Users and Groups in the ServiceNow Application Navigator and opens the sys_user list of platform users.

kis.title: Active Interactions List Page
kis.description: List page displaying open and in-progress user interactions.
kis.content: The Active Interactions list page (interaction_list.do) displays active interaction records filtered by default with 'State not in (Closed Complete, Closed Abandoned)'. Columns include Number, Opened, Short description, Opened for, State, Type, Assigned to, Updated, and Updated by.

kis.title: All Assets List
kis.description: The list page displaying all assets in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The All Assets list page (alm_asset_list.do) under Portfolios > All Assets displays asset records with columns including Asset tag, Display name, Model category, Class, Assigned to, Location, Company, Department, State, Warranty expiration, and Order received. It supports list-header search and condition-builder filtering.

kis.title: Asset Form
kis.description: The form page for individual asset records in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Asset record form (alm_asset.do) under Portfolios shows asset details across tabs including General, Financial, Contracts, Activities, and Depreciation. Read-only fields include Display name, Model category, Model, Configuration Item, Quantity, and Class. Editable fields on the General section include Asset tag, State, Substate, Assigned to, Managed by, Owned by, Parent, Location, Department, Company, Asset function, Assigned date, and Installed date. Related lists include Assets and Expense Lines.

attributes.read_only_fields: Display name, Model category, Model, Configuration Item, Quantity, Class
attributes.sections: Asset form section, General form section

kis.title: Assets list
kis.description: ServiceNow list view displaying all asset records.
kis.content: The Assets list page displays inventory records under Asset > Portfolios > All Assets. Columns include Asset tag, Display name, Model category, Class, Assigned to, Location, Company, Department, State, Warranty expiration, Comments, and PO number. It supports inline editing, column search, row action selections, and advanced filtering and sorting.

kis.title: Catalog Item Form
kis.description: The form used to view and edit catalog item definitions.
kis.content: The Catalog Item form in ServiceNow displays catalog item definition details. It features tabs for Item Details, Process Engine, Picture, Pricing, and Portal Settings. The fields State, Checked out, and Application are read-only. Related lists include Variables, Variable Sets, Catalog UI Policies, Catalog Client Scripts, Available For, Not Available For, Categories, Catalogs, Catalog Data Lookup Definitions, Related Articles, Related Catalog Items, and Assigned Topics. The form provides action buttons including Update, Copy, Try It, Edit in Catalog Builder, and Delete.

kis.title: Catalog Items List
kis.description: List page displaying Service Catalog items
kis.content: The Catalog Items list page (sc_cat_item_list.do) displays records from the sc_cat_item table, including item Name, Short description, Category, Price, and Class, and provides filter controls to build complex AND/OR filter queries.

attributes.sections: Catalog Items filtering toolbar, Filter controls, Catalog Items table

kis.title: Change Request Form
kis.description: ServiceNow form for creating and editing change requests.
kis.content: The Change Request form (change_request.do) is used to create and update change requests. It displays stage progression (New, Assess, Authorize, Scheduled, Implement, Review, Closed, Canceled) and includes top-level fields: Number, Category, Service, Service offering, Configuration item, Risk, Impact, Model, Type (read-only), State, Conflict status (read-only), Conflict last run (read-only), Assignment group, Assigned to, Short description, and Description. Subtabs include Planning, Schedule, Conflicts, Notes, and Closure Information. Default values on a new record are Category 'Other', Risk 'Moderate', Impact '3 - Low', State 'New', Conflict status 'Not Run', and Close code '-- None --'.

kis.title: Change Requests list
kis.description: List page displaying change requests in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Change Requests list displays change records. Visible table columns include Number, Short description, Risk, Impact, Priority, Assigned to, Planned start date, Planned end date, Implementation plan, and Approval.

attributes.sections: Change Requests, filtering toolbar; Filter; Change Requests

kis.title: Change Requests List Page
kis.description: The list view page showing change request records in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Change Requests list view displays records under the Change application. It contains a filtering toolbar with List controls, Show / hide filter, Show / hide natural language filter, a search field dropdown, search box, Actions on selected rows dropdown, and a New button. Columns include Select All checkbox, Number, Short description, Risk, Impact, Priority, Assigned to, Planned start date, Planned end date, Implementation plan, Approval, Justification, Created, and Created by.

kis.title: Create Change Request Landing Page
kis.description: ServiceNow landing page for selecting a change model when creating a change request.
kis.content: The Create Change Request landing page (sn_chg_model_ui_landing.do) allows users to select a change model to initiate a change request. Tabs include Pinned, Models, Preapproved, and All. Under the Models tab, users can select models including 'Emergency' and 'Normal'.

kis.title: Dashboards Overview
kis.description: The dashboard overview and management page in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Dashboards Overview page ($pa_dashboards_overview.do) provides access to dashboards across four tabs: Recent, Owned by Me, Shared with Me, and All. It features a dashboard search field, an 'All Groups Group filter' dropdown, and a 'Create New Dashboard' button.

attributes.tabs: Recent, Owned by Me, Shared with Me, All

kis.title: Data Management Delete Job form
kis.description: Form used to configure, preview, and execute Data Management Delete Jobs.
kis.content: The Data Management Delete Job form (sys_dm_delete.do) manages bulk deletion jobs. Number and State are read-only, Table is mandatory, and it includes Condition, 'Run business rules and engines', and 'Run at' fields. It features a 'Preview' button, Related Links 'Preview Cascade' and 'Execute Now', and a related list for 'Data Management Deletion Counts'.

kis.title: Dependency Views Map
kis.description: Interactive dependency map viewer in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Dependency Views Map page ($ngbsm.do) presents an interactive CI dependency map. It features layout mode tabs (Vertical, Horizontal, Radial, Force, Group), a 'Search for CI' box, Details and Map Settings buttons, and pan/zoom controls (Up, Right, Down, Left, Fit to screen, Zoom in, Zoom out, Switch mode).

kis.title: Developer Laptop (Mac) Item Order Page
kis.description: Catalog item order view page for Developer Laptop (Mac)
kis.content: The item order page for Developer Laptop (Mac) displays hardware specs, optional software checkboxes (Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop, Eclipse IDE), an 'Additional software requirements' text area, and an 'Order this Item' section showing Price ($1,499.00 + $100.00 Annually), Quantity dropdown (default 1, values 1-10), Subtotal, Delivery time (5 Days), and an 'Order Now' button.

kis.title: Elements Filters List
kis.description: List page displaying Performance Analytics Elements Filters.
kis.content: The Elements Filters list page (pa_filters_list.do) displays breakdown element filters. It contains standard list controls including search, filter controls, 'Personalize List', a 'New' button, and table columns: Title, Breakdown source, Filter, and Roles.

kis.title: Expense Line Form
kis.description: ServiceNow form for viewing and editing individual expense line records.
kis.content: The Expense Line form (fm_expense_line.do) contains two main sections: Expense Line (with fields Number, Date, Inherited checkbox, Source ID document lookup, Currency Type dropdown, Amount, Process date, State dropdown, and Short description) and Source (with reference lookups for Asset, Fixed asset, Contract, User, Configuration Item, Task, and Cost center). It also includes an Expense Lines related list below the form.

kis.title: Expense Lines list
kis.description: List view for ServiceNow Expense Lines (fm_expense_line_list.do).
kis.content: The Expense Lines list (fm_expense_line_list.do) displays expense line records. Its field search dropdown includes Number, User, Inherited, Parent, Date, Short description, Source ID, Amount, Type, and Summary type. Its table columns match these fields. 'Actions on selected rows' contains Delete, Delete with preview..., Create Application File, and tag options.

kis.title: Filter Form
kis.description: Form used to create and configure saved filters in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Filter form (sys_filter.do) is used to create and configure saved list filters. It contains fields for Title, Table (combobox/reference), Filter (condition builder supporting AND/OR conditions and sorting), and Application, which is read-only and defaults to 'Global'.

kis.title: Filters list
kis.description: List page for saved sys_filter records in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Filters list page (sys_filter_list.do) displays saved list filter records. Its grid columns include Title, Table, Filter, Updated, Roles, Mobile, User, and Last used.

kis.title: Hardware Asset Form
kis.description: ServiceNow Hardware Asset form page
kis.content: The Hardware Asset form (alm_hardware) displays asset details. The top section contains read-only fields: Display name, Model category, Model, Configuration Item, and Quantity. Below is a tab list with tabs General, Financial, Disposal, Depreciation, Contracts, Entitlements, and Activities. The General tab contains Asset tag, State, Serial number, Substate, Assigned to, Managed by, Owned by, Parent, Class (read-only), Location, Department, Company, Asset function, Assigned date, Installed date, and Comments. Below the form are related list tabs Assets and Expense Lines.

kis.title: Hardware Assets
kis.description: Hardware Assets list page in ServiceNow under Asset > Portfolios.
kis.content: The Hardware Assets list page (alm_hardware_list.do) is located in the Asset module under Portfolios. It displays hardware records with columns: Display name, Model category, Serial number, Assigned to, Company, Cost center, State, Configuration Item, Purchased, and Warranty expiration. The page supports inline table editing, column search rows, and filtering.

kis.title: Hardware Assets list
kis.description: List page for hardware assets in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Hardware Assets list page (alm_hardware_list.do) displays hardware asset records. Its grid columns include Display name, Model category, Serial number, Assigned to, Company, Cost center, State, Configuration Item, Purchased, and Warranty expiration. The field-specific search dropdown includes options: for text, Display name, Model category, Serial number, Assigned to, Company, Cost center, State, Configuration Item, Purchased, and Warranty expiration.

kis.title: Hardware Assets List Page
kis.description: The list view of hardware asset records in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Hardware Assets list page (alm_hardware_list.do) displays hardware assets with columns including Display name, Model category, Serial number, Assigned to, Company, Cost center, State, Configuration item, Purchased, and Warranty expiration. It supports column search rows and condition filtering.

kis.title: Hardware list
kis.description: ServiceNow list view displaying hardware asset records.
kis.content: The Hardware list page (alm_hardware_list.do) displays hardware asset records. Its list columns include Display name, Model category, Serial number, Assigned to, Company, Cost center, State, Configuration Item, Purchased, and Warranty expiration. Filter controls include condition builders with dropdown field selection, operator selection, value inputs, and a Run filter button.

kis.title: Identifiers List
kis.description: CI Identifiers list page displaying identification rules in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Identifiers list page (cmdb_identifier_list.do) displays CI identification rules under Configuration > Identification/Reconciliation > CI Identifiers. It displays columns Name, Active, Applies to, Description, and Independent, with search options for for text, Name, Active, Applies to, Description, and Independent.

kis.title: Incident form
kis.description: Form page used to view, create, and resolve incident records.
kis.content: The Incident form is used to create and update incident records. It features mandatory fields Caller and Short description, and a read-only Priority field that automatically recalculates based on Impact. Form tabs include Notes and Resolution Information.

attributes.sections: Incident form section, Notes form section, Related Links

kis.title: Incident Form (Default View)
kis.description: Standard Incident record form page in Default view.
kis.content: The Default view of the Incident form in ServiceNow contains fields Number, Caller (mandatory), Category, Subcategory, Service, Service offering, Configuration item, Channel, State, Impact, Urgency, Priority (read-only), Assignment group, Assigned to, Short description (mandatory), and Description. Form tabs include Notes, Related Records, and Resolution Information. Related list tabs below the form include Task SLAs, Affected CIs, Impacted Services/CIs, and Child Incidents.

attributes.sections: Incident, Notes, Related Records, Resolution Information

kis.title: Incident List
kis.description: List view displaying incident records in ServiceNow.
kis.content: The Incident List (incident_list.do) displays incident records in tabular format. It includes a search bar for specific fields (such as Number, Opened, Short description), an activity stream flyout button, a filter breadcrumbs toolbar, and a List controls menu with options for View, Filters, Group By, Show, Refresh List, and Create Favorite.

kis.title: Incidents List
kis.description: ServiceNow Incidents list view under Service Desk

kis.title: Agent Workload Balancing
kis.description: Company protocol KB0010104 for balancing problem workloads among agents.
kis.content: Protocol KB0010104 ('Agent Workload Balancing') in the Company Protocols knowledge base defines the process for redistributing workload among agents for problems tagged with a specific hashtag. The steps are: 1. Identify the user with the most assigned problems (busiest) and least assigned problems (least busy) among problems with descriptions containing the required hashtag via the report 'Problems for with hashtag [hashtag]'. 2. Locate a problem with the lowest priority (priority=5 - Planning) that includes the appropriate hashtag in the problem statement and is assigned to the busiest user. 3. Re-assign the identified low-priority problem to the least busy user.

kis.title: Dashboard Retrieve Information and Perform Task

kis.title: Managing Your Existing Expenses
kis.description: Protocol for identifying and handling duplicate expense lines.
kis.content: Company protocol KB0010109 defining rules to identify and resolve duplicate expense lines. Expense lines are grouped by hashtags in their short description. Duplicate expense lines sharing identical short descriptions are resolved with the following precedence: 1. Keep only lines linked to tasks (e.g., Change Request, Incident) and delete others; 2. If all or none are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest; 3. If dates are the same, keep only the most expensive; 4. If costs are also identical, any duplicate may be kept.

kis.title: Filtering records in a ServiceNow list
kis.content:
To filter records on a list page such as Incidents:
1. Click the 'Show / hide filter' button beside the list title to display the filter controls panel.
2. Set the condition criteria using the field combobox, operator combobox (such as 'is', 'is not', 'is empty', 'is not empty', 'starts with', 'ends with', 'contains'), and value field.
3. Click 'Add a new AND filter condition' or 'Add OR filter: Add a new section of filter conditions' to append further conditions.
4. To remove unwanted conditions, click the 'Remove condition' button next to a row or click 'Remove next condition' on the breadcrumb trail above the list.
5. Click 'Run filter' to refresh the list with the selected criteria.

kis.title: Balancing Agent Workload for Problem Records
kis.content: To balance agent workload for problems containing a hashtag per company protocol: 1. Navigate to Reports (sys_report_list.do) and search for the report named 'Problems for with hashtag #[hashtag]' to find the busiest agent (highest count) and least busy agent (lowest count). 2. Navigate to Problems (problem_list.do) and filter by 'Problem statement contains #[hashtag]' and 'Assigned to is [busiest agent]'. 3. Open the problem record having priority '5 - Planning'. 4. Update the 'Assigned to' field to the least busy agent and click 'Update'. 5. Return to the task record (Private Task), set its State to 'Closed Complete', and click 'Update'.

kis.title: Filtering Expense Lines by hashtag requires 'contains' operator
kis.content: Searching for an investment project hashtag in the Expense Lines list header search creates a 'greater than or equal to' condition, while using the column search row defaults to 'starts with'. Because hashtags in expense line short descriptions are placed at the end of the text, both methods return zero results. To filter expense lines by hashtag, open the filter builder and explicitly set the operator for Short description to 'contains'.

kis.title: Filtering a list by multiple field values
kis.content:

kis.title: Protocol rules for duplicate expense line resolution
kis.content: Under company protocol "Managing Your Existing Expenses" (KB0010109), duplicate expense lines (those with identical short descriptions sharing a hashtag) are resolved by the following hierarchy: 1. Keep only expense lines linked to tasks (e.g., Change Request, Incident) and delete the others. 2. If all duplicates or no duplicates are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest one by date. 3. If all duplicates share the same date, keep only the most expensive one. 4. If all duplicates share the same cost, any of the expenses may be kept.

kis.title: Protocol rules for handling duplicate expense lines
kis.content: Per company protocol "Managing Your Existing Expenses" (KB0010109), duplicate expense lines are defined as expense lines sharing the same short description within a given hashtag group. Duplicates must be resolved using the following priority rules: keep only lines linked to tasks (such as Change Requests or Incidents) and delete unlinked ones; if all or none are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest record; if dates are identical, keep the most expensive record; if costs are identical, any may be kept.

kis.title: Investment allocation rules under Maximizing total investment return protocol
kis.content: Under the company protocol 'Maximizing total investment return' (KB0010110), investment projects are filed as expense lines tagged with project ID hashtags in their Short description. Project returns are stated in the Short description (e.g., '- Return: <amount>$') and project costs are given in the Amount field. When tasked with maximizing investment return within a budget, review the tagged expense lines, evaluate their costs and returns, and select the combination of projects that yields the highest total return without exceeding the budget. Output requirements may specify reporting the total return only, the selected investment numbers only, both, or deleting unselected investment lines.

kis.title: Rules for Handling Duplicate Expense Lines
kis.content: Under company protocol "Managing Your Existing Expenses" (KB0010109), duplicate expense lines (those sharing the same short description and hashtag) are resolved by applying the following priority rules: (1) Keep only duplicate lines linked to tasks (e.g., Change Request, Incident) and delete the others; (2) If all duplicates are linked to tasks or none are, keep only the oldest record; (3) If all duplicates have the same date, keep only the most expensive one; (4) If all duplicates have the same cost, any of the duplicate records can be kept.

kis.title: Maintain Items module location

kis.title: Committing field selection in list filter builder

kis.title: Global search exact match dropdown navigation

kis.title: Deleting Expense Lines via Form vs Actions on Selected Rows

kis.title: Service Catalog homepage layout

kis.title: Requested Item form hides Requested for in Self Service view

kis.title: Navigating modules vs global search

kis.title: Private Task form Priority field options

kis.title: Duplicate expense lines deletion rule
kis.content: Under company protocol KB0010142 ('Managing Your Existing Expenses'), expense lines must be reviewed to ensure no duplicate entries remain; when duplicate short descriptions exist, redundant expense lines should be deleted, keeping only one.

kis.title: Duplicate expense lines resolution rules
kis.content: Under the 'Managing Your Existing Expenses' company protocol (KB0010109), duplicate expense lines sharing the same short description and hashtag must be resolved using the following priority order: 1. Keep only expenses linked to tasks (such as Incident or Change Request) and delete the unlinked duplicates. 2. If all or none of the duplicates are linked to tasks, keep only the oldest expense line. 3. If duplicates share the same date, keep only the most expensive one. 4. If duplicates also share the same cost, any of the duplicate expenses may be retained.

kis.content: The Impact and Urgency dropdown fields on the Incident form both include the choices '1 - High', '2 - Medium', and '3 - Low'.

kis.title: Column header search requires pressing Enter to apply
kis.content: When filtering a ServiceNow table list via the column search row, entering a query into a column search box does not automatically trigger filtering; the user must press Enter while focused in the search box to apply the filter.

kis.title: Incident form tabs and related lists
kis.content: The ServiceNow Incident form contains the section tabs Notes, Related Records, and Resolution Information, and related lists for Task SLAs, Affected CIs, Impacted Services/CIs, and Child Incidents.

kis.title: Highcharts Report View Drilldown Button Unresponsiveness
kis.content: In ServiceNow report views (sys_report_template.do) rendering Highcharts bar charts, clicking the 'View chart menu' button or 'Report info' button may fail to open drilldown or view-data menus. To access and edit the underlying records, navigate directly to the Problem list (problem_list.do) and apply the filter conditions manually.

kis.title: Location of Hardware Assets module
kis.content: The Hardware Assets module is located in the application navigator under Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets.

kis.title: Location of Problems list
kis.content: In ServiceNow, the complete list of problem records is accessed via the All navigation menu under Problem > All.

kis.title: Selecting Model auto-populates Cost on Hardware Asset form
kis.content: On the Hardware Asset form (alm_hardware.do), selecting a Model (such as 'Cyberpower Gamer Ultra 2098') automatically populates the Cost field on the Financial tab with that model's default price ($549.99).

kis.title: Requested Item form default values and behavior
kis.content: On the Requested Item (sc_req_item) form, the 'Requested for' field defaults to the current logged-in user, 'Quantity' defaults to 1, 'State' defaults to 'Open' (options: Pending, Open, Work in Progress, Closed Complete, Closed Incomplete, Closed Skipped), and 'Stage' defaults to 'waiting_for_approval' and is read-only.

kis.title: Incidents List specific field search options
kis.content: The Incidents list offers a field search dropdown with 11 choices: 'for text', 'Number', 'Caller', 'Category', 'Priority', 'Impact', 'State', 'Short description', 'Assigned to', 'Company', and 'Created'.

kis.title: Incidents list navigation
kis.content: The Incidents list is located under Service Desk > Incidents in the ServiceNow application navigator.

kis.title: Onboarding a new user protocol requirements
kis.content: Under the company protocol 'Onboarding a new user', onboarding requires completing three procedures: creating a User record with user and locale details, ordering the employee's requested laptop/computer via the Service Catalog, and creating a Hardware Asset assigned to the new user.

kis.title: Column options menu lacks secondary sort option
kis.content: In ServiceNow Classic list view, the column header options menu does not provide a secondary sort or 'Then by' option for multi-column sorting.

kis.title: Private Task form State field options
kis.content: On the Private Task form, the State dropdown includes the options: Pending, Open, Work in Progress, Closed Complete, Closed Incomplete, and Closed Skipped.

kis.title: Asset form section tabs layout
kis.content: On the Asset form (alm_asset), the section tabs appear in the order: General, Financial, Contracts, Activities, and Depreciation. Related lists below include Assets and Expense Lines.

kis.title: Ordering hardware items from the Service Catalog
kis.content: To order hardware items in ServiceNow, navigate to Self-Service > Service Catalog > Hardware, select the desired item (e.g., iPad pro), configure mandatory options such as colour and storage, select the Quantity from the dropdown (options 1 through 10), and click 'Order Now'.

kis.title: Location of Reports View / Run Module
kis.content: The Reports View / Run module is located under Reports > View / Run in the All navigation menu.

kis.title: Confirmation modal required when deleting records
kis.content: Clicking 'Delete' on a record form does not immediately remove the record; ServiceNow triggers a 'Confirmation' dialog modal asking 'Delete this record?' with 'Cancel' and 'Delete' buttons, requiring a second click on 'Delete' to finalize deletion.

kis.title: Private Task form Priority field options
kis.content: On the Private Task form, the Priority dropdown field includes the options: 1 - Critical, 2 - High, 3 - Moderate, 4 - Low, and 5 - Planning.

kis.title: Personalize list columns button location
kis.content: The 'Update Personalized List' button (gear icon) is located at the top left of the list column headers above the record table and opens the Personalize List Columns dialog to add, remove, and reorder columns.

kis.title: All Assets Location in Navigation Menu
kis.content: The All Assets module is located in the ServiceNow Application Navigator under Portfolios > All Assets.

kis.title: User form mandatory fields
kis.content: On the ServiceNow User form (sys_user.do), the mandatory fields that must be populated before submission are User ID, First name, Last name, and Email.

kis.title: Filtering ServiceNow Lists Using Column Search Row
kis.content: To filter a ServiceNow list view by a specific column, click 'Show column search row' in the column header, type the search criterion into the column's search box, and press Enter.

kis.title: Hardware Asset currency fields and options
kis.content: On the Hardware Asset form, Cost (Financial tab) and Resale price (Disposal tab) default to 0.00 and have a Currency Type selector defaulting to '$' with options: $, CHF, £, ¥, and €.

kis.title: Incident Form mandatory and read-only fields
kis.content: On the ServiceNow Incident form, Caller and Short description are mandatory fields, while Priority is read-only and automatically calculated from Impact and Urgency.

kis.title: Interaction Active module location
kis.content: The Active interactions module is located in the ServiceNow Application Navigator under Interaction > Active.

kis.title: Building list filters using condition builder
kis.content: To filter records on a list page such as Incidents, click the 'Show / hide filter' button on the filtering toolbar to open the condition builder, select the field from the field combobox, select an operator from the operator dropdown, provide the target value, and add additional criteria with 'Add AND Condition' or 'Add OR Condition'.

kis.title: Saving a list filter can reset custom URL query conditions
kis.content: In the ServiceNow filter builder panel, clicking 'Save' to save a custom filter can reload the list URL to incident_list.do and strip custom query parameters or fields (such as u_* fields) from the active filter. Avoid saving when only applying a transient or query-parameter filter to a list.

kis.title: Private Task State dropdown options
kis.content: On the Private Task form, the State dropdown field includes the options: 'Pending', 'Open', 'Work in Progress', 'Closed Complete', 'Closed Incomplete', and 'Closed Skipped'.
